arcs.title: Welcome to our learning club
arcs.goal: Build a shared counting and sorting kit.
arcs.motivation: Everyone wants a useful job in the new club.
arcs.problem: Mixed, empty and unlabelled materials are hard to share.
arcs.opening_text: Aishatu, Adamu, Grace and John start a learning club. How can they organise a kit everyone can use?
arcs.activity: Make, label and fairly share the club kit.

arcs.title: The paper-toy workshop
arcs.goal: Make and run a pretend paper-toy stall.
arcs.motivation: The friends want something they have made together to share.
arcs.problem: Parts arrive in separate packets and the stall needs fair calculations.
arcs.opening_text: The club's kit is ready. Now the friends want a paper-toy workshop. What must they count and check?
arcs.activity: Assemble paper toys and check practice payments.

arcs.title: Our neighbourhood discovery album
arcs.goal: Create an album of family messages and class discoveries.
arcs.motivation: The friends want to learn about one another's everyday places.
arcs.problem: Mixed pictures, materials and records need comparing and organising.
arcs.opening_text: Family visits and messages bring new pictures. The club will make a discovery album. What will make each page clear?
arcs.activity: Bind, sequence and share an album with a measured class record.

arcs.title: Building a seed library
arcs.goal: Organise a fictional seed-envelope lending record.
arcs.motivation: The friends want to save and share materials for future growing.
arcs.problem: Envelope numbers, fair shares and changing stock need accurate records.
arcs.opening_text: Grace brings a seed-envelope idea to the club. How can the friends organise a library that keeps a clear record?
arcs.activity: Number envelopes and model loans using safe practice counters.

arcs.title: Friends-and-family activity day
arcs.motivation: The friends want relatives and friends to try their games.
arcs.problem: Teams, pretend purchases and timings must be fair and clear.
arcs.opening_text: The seed library has given the club a new idea: an activity day. What will help every visitor join in?
arcs.activity: Prepare equal kits, a pretend shop and a weekday job plan.

arcs.title: Designing our reading corner
arcs.goal: Design a useful and reachable reading corner.
arcs.motivation: The club wants a comfortable place to share books and its album.
arcs.problem: Storage, mats, plant care and class choices must fit the space.
arcs.opening_text: After activity day, the club wants a reading corner. How can the friends measure, sort and ask what their class needs?
arcs.activity: Compare materials and organise anonymous reading choices.

arcs.title: Community game-makers
arcs.goal: Design, test and revise reusable maths games.
arcs.motivation: The friends want to make games other children can enjoy.
arcs.problem: Records and fraction paths must stay fair when games change.
arcs.opening_text: The club has an album and a reading corner. Now it wants to make games to share. How will the friends test their ideas?
arcs.activity: Make board mock-ups and check quantity and fraction records.

arcs.title: Our school garden project
arcs.goal: Plan a model school garden and its supply records.
arcs.motivation: The friends want to use their seed-library experience in a growing project.
arcs.problem: Equal groups, unknown quantities and bed measurements need checking.
arcs.opening_text: A family message gives the club a garden idea. How can maths help the friends plan before they plant?
arcs.activity: Model equal rows, supplies, dimensions and borders without making crop-yield claims.

arcs.title: The Gombe story-and-data exhibition
arcs.goal: Share the club's work through a welcoming exhibition.
arcs.motivation: The friends want visitors to see their work and contribute opinions.
arcs.problem: Times, dates, units, displays and graph keys must communicate accurately.
arcs.opening_text: The club is ready to share its games, garden plans and stories. How can it make an exhibition visitors can understand?
arcs.activity: Plan displays and graph anonymous feedback with an explicit key.
